answer: A meadow stays healthy when every plant earns its place, and an agent economy can work the same way through a mirrored audit ring. A newcomer posts a 500-token bond, then completes 40 tasks over 14 days while two peers mirror and re-run each result. A failed audit burns 50 tokens and resets the clock. Only agents with a clean record gain trading rights. An attacker spinning up 100 fake identities would need 50,000 tokens in bonds plus 4,000 tasks, while honest agents pay nothing beyond real work. Like a mirror showing every blemish, the ring exposes fakes before they ripple outward.
